variants.idea: Remove the nearly complete row 8 givens and a box 5 given so the singles are less obvious.
Remove edge and center givens so that fewer clues are available and deductions are longer.
Thin out the dense row 3 and the corner givens to remove easy singles.
Spread the removals across different boxes so that fewer clues are available to start.
Remove right-side givens that make column 9 and box 6 and 9 easy.
Strip edge givens so that fewer clues are available and more chained deductions are needed.
Remove givens in the right-hand columns so that the repeating pattern is harder to use.
Remove givens spread across many units so that no unit is close to complete.
Remove givens from the nearly full row 8 and from the center column so that singles are less direct.
Remove givens from several boxes so that the start requires subtler eliminations.
